name: oMLX
description: Manage one or more oMLX servers from Orca’s sidebar: named connections with per-server API keys in encrypted secrets, load and unload models, watch memory and live requests, edit base settings, and restart without leaving your workspace.

cover.alt: oMLX open in Orca’s sidebar beside the editor, showing memory, loaded models, and generation speed on the Pulses tab

screenshots.alt: oMLX Models tab listing MLX models with load state and size
screenshots.caption: Browse the model catalog, then load, unload, pin, or set a default

screenshots.alt: oMLX Pulses tab with memory meter, request stats, and tokens per second
screenshots.caption: Watch memory, catalog mix, and live tokens per second

screenshots.alt: oMLX Running tab showing a loaded model and an active generation request
screenshots.caption: Inspect loaded models and stop a single request

screenshots.alt: oMLX Settings tab with host, port, and log level under Server
screenshots.caption: Edit host, port, scheduler, memory guard, and sampling defaults

settings.title: Status poll interval
settings.description: How often the status bar asks the active oMLX connection which models are loaded. 0 pauses background polling.
